anomalies.observed: FLOAT_LOW (NET0062) is pulled up to +3V3 via R5. It drives T8 base via R12. T8 collector is on /NET0055, which is pulled up to +3V3 via R16 and drives T5 gate. T5 is the main pump low-side switch. When FLOAT_LOW is low (water low), T8 is off, so /NET0055 is pulled high by R16, turning on T5 and running the main pump.
anomalies.expected: The low-level float switch should cut off the main pump when water is low. FLOAT_LOW low should turn off T5, not turn it on.

evidence.quote: float-switch interlocks for low-level pump cutoff

anomalies.impact: When the water level is low, the main circulation pump is turned on instead of being cut off, risking dry running and pump damage.

anomalies.observed: C56 (100n) is connected between NET0079 (FLOAT_HIGH) and +3V3.
anomalies.expected: A filter capacitor on a digital input should be connected to GND, as is C49 on the other float input (NET0062 to GND).
anomalies.impact: The FLOAT_HIGH input lacks proper filtering to ground and instead couples the +3V3 supply into the input, potentially causing false triggering or noise.

parsed.summary: The design files contain two anomalies: the low-level float switch interlock is inverted, causing the main pump to turn on when water is low, and C56 is connected to +3V3 instead of GND, compromising the FLOAT_HIGH input filter.
